entities.summary: Louisa Hanoune is an Algerian politician, and the head of the Workers' Party (PT). In 2004, she became the first woman to run for President of Algeria. Hanoune was imprisoned by the government several times before the legalization of political parties in 1988. She was jailed soon after she joined the Trotskyist Social Workers Organisation, an illegal party, in 1981 and again after the 1988 October Riots, which brought about the end of the National Liberation Front's (FLN) single-party rule.
